brief:
Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz said Wednesday that Israel will continue its occupation of territory in Gaza, Lebanon and Syria for the indefinite future, Middle East Eye reported. Katz did not specify conditions for withdrawal or a timeline for the occupation of the three territories.

The statement marks an explicit commitment to long-term military control across multiple neighbouring countries amid ongoing conflict in the region.
dek: Israeli defence minister says Israel will indefinitely occupy Gaza, Lebanon, Syria Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz said on Wednesday that Israel will continue its illegal occupation of territory in Gaza, Lebanon and Syria for the indefinite future.
title: Israeli Defence Minister Says Israel Will Indefinitely Occupy Gaza, Lebanon, Syria
